question: What changed between the preserved105000 L1 n1 checkpoint and one availability-selected current checkpoint, in optimization state, inference calibration, physical readout, geometry and four-step prediction?
hypothesis: More training may improve accessible positions without equivalently improving action-conditioned rollout. Frozen train-only calibration can separate saved BatchNorm effects from learned-state differences; temporal improvement is not evidence of superiority over L0 or of a reboot effect.

sources.consequence: Separate noncollapse, Euclidean geometry, linear physical accessibility and prediction/planning. Use only frozen readouts; disclose local4096-window ridge1e-3 versus paper50000/ridge1e-6 and original auxiliary-head gradient deviation. Poor linear decoding is not proof of absent information.

Freeze learned weights; calibrate population moments using training windows only, encoder before predictor; retain saved-statistics diagnostics without treating batch-statistic inference as deployment.

sources.sections: Batched versus sliced computations and finite/conditioning caveats
sources.consequence: Use CPUfloat64/math attention, finite state/gradients, actual batch/single/permutation checks and an independent ridge normal-equation residual. Explicitly do not claim GPU parity for these later checkpoints.

sources.sections: Parameter IDs, groups and state pairing
sources.consequence: Compare finite optimizer counters and mapping to the preserved input; verify resumed updates independently of the nominal checkpoint step. Do not modify live or saved training state.
Bound CPU stages externally and preserve partial outputs on failure. Only the owned analysis child may be stopped; never signal the trainer.

differences: The user explicitly requested CPU checkpoint analysis while original GPU training continues. This is a declared CPU reference experiment, including a closed-form diagnostic ridge fit, not neural-network training or a training fallback. It uses validation rather than final test data and a single training seed. Current versus105000 is within L1 n1, not an equal-step arm comparison. Later-checkpoint GPU parity and final A003/P25/P26 gates remain pending.
contrary_evidence: A latent loss change can reflect scale or BatchNorm; good position readout can coexist with poor dynamics/planning. Low linear/geometry scores need not mean information is absent. Action reversal may preserve net displacement away from boundaries; include zero-action and no-rollout controls. Shared frames/pairs are dependent, so resample complete episodes for probe uncertainty and make no independent-pair geometry significance claim.

protocol.snapshot: Copy preserved A005 L1n1 checkpoint/config/metrics and one latest completed A014 L1n1 checkpoint through open inodes after preregistration. Select current by availability, not score; bind source inode metadata, source/data/config/code hashes and retained complete metric rows. Never modify trainer files. Freeze this current snapshot for both phases.
protocol.state_and_curves: Check finite model/head/optimizer/scheduler/RNG state; original config; optimizer ID/order; each final used counter equals105000 input counter plus current_step-105000; scheduler cursor matches step. Summarize logged losses/gradients and rolling median training prediction error versus validation, explicitly without an overfitting diagnosis from ratios alone.
protocol.calibration_phase: Both frozen checkpoints use the existing A003 CPU reference implementations:64 train/val diagnostic windows seed42, all four BatchNorm modes,4096 train-only calibration windows seed17 batch64, encoder before predictor. CPUfloat64, math attention, rtol1e-4/atol1e-5. Verify finite state and gradients, unchanged learned weights, and repeat/single/reversed grouping before/after. Save derived inference-only checkpoints. Review the joint calibration/state result before probes.
protocol.probe_phase: For each reviewed calibrated checkpoint, independently fit fixed ridge1e-3 on4096 identical sampled train encoder features with train standardization and an unpenalized intercept. Seed vector[2026111520,1,split_is_val]. Score identical5 windows from each100 validation episodes (500 scenes), history3, future4, batch32. Decoder frozen for current, factual rollout, reversed future actions, zero future actions and no rollout; preserve both historical actions. Add independently encoded true future frames as a representation-only reference. Never supply these future frames to rollout. Targets are red XY and one white XY in pixels; no permutation ambiguity at n1. No hyperparameter selection or test access.
protocol.statistics: Report per-coordinate Pearson with2000 episode-cluster bootstrap intervals and red/white position RMSE. Paired mean squared-position-error gains use the same episode resamples for factual versus each control and current-checkpoint versus105000. Positive temporal gain means later has smaller error; uncertainty is conditional on these two checkpoints and validation episodes, not training seeds. Geometry uses2000 fixed cross-episode pairs from the same500 current scenes: latent L2 versus red/white XY L2 Spearman, latent coordinate SD and mean pair distance. Geometry is descriptive only.
protocol.verification: Check finite extracted features/readout/predictions, ridge relative residual<=1e-8, actual first8 validation cases single versus batch and reversed grouping for all feature modes, unchanged model state/checkpoint/data bytes and no CUDA initialization. Software checks cover train/val-only deterministic sampling, action controls preserving history, n1 paired-gain sign/episode grouping and exact-reference ridge recovery. Preserve full sampled indices, predictions, decoder, metrics and standalone PNG/PDF plots.
protocol.review: Read the primary sources after each phase result before interpreting or running dependent work. Retain positive/negative/mixed findings. These measurements cannot pass any final numerical, planning or generalization gate, change the original trainer, or justify a silent retry of A007.

success: A reproducible temporal checkpoint comparison with substantive literature review and useful limits, regardless of the sign of scientific effects.
stop: No GPU context, model parameter updates, test split or new simulation. Stop on changed source/lineage, nonfinite state, numerical grouping failure, decoder residual failure, CPU stage wall time900s or RSS above16GB. Preserve any partial result and review before dependent work. No automatic parameter/tolerance changes.
